## Core Product Categories & Offerings
- **Raw Pure Honey**: 100% natural, unprocessed Pure Forest Honey harvested by trusted beekeepers in Western Ghats, Kanyakumari.
- **Dehydrated Farm Powders**: Natural Nendran Banana Powder, Dates Powder, Beetroot Powder, Carrot Powder, Pineapple Powder, and Sweet Potato Powder.
- **Cold-Pressed Oils**: Pure Coconut Oil, Sesame Oil, and Groundnut Oil extracted via traditional cold-press wooden mills without chemical additives.
- **Nutritional Superfoods**: Moringa Leaf Powder, Moringa Capsules, Makhana (Fox Nuts), Natural Himalayan Pink Salt, and Jaggery Powder.
